annotations.title: Live planning constraints on a building plot

description: Looks up, live from official open data, what applies at the customer's postcode before an extension, loft, porch, outbuilding or groundworks: Article 4 directions (permitted development removed), listed buildings, conservation areas, World Heritage Sites, National Landscapes, scheduled monuments, flood risk zones and Tree Preservation Orders (planning.data.gov.uk, England, councils that publish). Returns each constraint found with its source link, what it means for the build, and the `designations` to pass straight to check_permitted_development. A constraint not found is not proof of none: the answer says so. Example: {"postcode":"YO1 7HH"}.
name: site_constraints
title: Live planning constraints on a building plot
